highlights.title: Australia Senate Requests OpenAI, Anthropic CEOs Face AI Inquiry
highlights.description: The heads of artificial intelligence firms OpenAI and Anthropic PBC have been called on to appear before an Australian Senate inquiry to answer questions after the recent revelation of a hack of a government website.

highlights.title: The smart home graveyard is getting crowded
highlights.description:

How it started
A decade ago, a group of former Apple engineers built a beautiful smart oven. With a built-in scale, restaurant-grade heating elements, a camera, and the intelligence to recognize a chicken breast and cook it perfectly, the June Oven set the standard for smart cooking appliances. highlights.title: China Media Says US Shares Responsibility for Managing AI
highlights.description: China and the US have the ability and responsibility to manage and develop artificial intelligence, according to a post published Sunday by Yuyuantantian, a social media account affiliated with state broadcaster China Central Television.

highlights.title: How AI Is Helping African Farmers Prepare for El Niño
highlights.description: Opportunity International's Tim Strong explains how a WhatsApp-based AI tool gives smallholder farmers locally relevant advice on what and when to plant. The technology is designed to help farmers make better decisions and reduce the cost of uncertainty as weather patterns become increasingly unpredictable. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Apple buried Copland 30 years ago. Now the failed OS boots in a browser
highlights.description: The final developer build offers a glimpse of the future Cupertino abandoned for NeXT

highlights.title: PNOE’s new face mask wants to make lab-grade breath testing a self-serve affair
highlights.description: PNOĒ, the Malden, Mass.-based startup whose breath-analyzing mask used to bear an unfortunate resemblance to Bane's, is launching a sleeker self-serve version on October 1 that lets gym-goers measure their VO₂ max and other metabolic markers in eight minutes without a trained operator.
